_about: THE CME SESSION CALENDAR — data, not code (owner ruling 2026-09-07).
It replaced a boolean. isCMEHoliday() returned true for every holiday and the
gate treated all of them as FULL closures, with the code's own comment saying
so: 'for v1 we treat them as full closures and refuse to trade. Refine in
Plan 3 if it becomes restrictive.' On 2026-09-07 it became restrictive: the
bot skipped every cycle of a Labor Day session in which MNQ traded 980 bars
across 153.50 points, and no LONDON plan was ever read.
SHORTENED SESSIONS ARE TRADING SESSIONS. A date is one of three things:
shortened  — trades normally until close_ct, then flat
(absent)   — a normal date; the weekly rules alone decide
EVERY ENTRY CITES A SOURCE. Where the source is an owner ruling rather than a
published schedule it says so, so a later reader can tell what was verified
from what was decided. CME republishes these each year: BEFORE A NEW YEAR IS
TRADED, the next year's block must be checked against CME Group's published
holiday calendar and its source lines updated. An absent year is not a year of
normal days — SessionCalendar reports the year as UNCOVERED and the caller
